Messages.Author: Daz
Messages.Body:
In a game yesterday I got out a Succubus club, and I was wondering
about a few transfers I made.
I used the Rack and then traded it. Legal? If this is legal and I had
another willing methusalea, could I use the Rack, trade it away, get
it back imediatly and let another vamp use it?
I used the Coven and then traded it. Legal? Will it still go to my
predator at the end of my turn?
I also got an army of rats and since it was my untap phase I used it.
Legal??? Could I then just trade it back?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Daz wrote:
>
> In a game yesterday I got out a Succubus club, and I was wondering
> about a few transfers I made.
> I used the Rack and then traded it. Legal? If this is legal and I had
> another willing methusalea, could I use the Rack, trade it away, get
> it back imediatly and let another vamp use it?

Yes.

> I used the Coven and then traded it. Legal? Will it still go to my
> predator at the end of my turn?

Yes.
No. It will go to its controller's predator at the end of its
controller's turn, by card text.

> I also got an army of rats and since it was my untap phase I used it.
> Legal??? Could I then just trade it back?

Yes. Yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
>
> Daz wrote:
> >
> > In a game yesterday I got out a Succubus club, and I was wondering
> > about a few transfers I made.
> > I used the Rack and then traded it. Legal? If this is legal and I had
> > another willing methusalea, could I use the Rack, trade it away, get
> > it back imediatly and let another vamp use it?
>
> Yes.

To be clear: you could choose a different vampire when you regained
control of the Rack, but you can't use it twice in the same untap
phase.
